abstract: A 39-year-old man experiencing cranial nerve symptoms was referred to our neurosurgery department after a brain tumor was detected on computed tomography (CT) scans at a local hospital. Due to convulsive symptoms, the patient was admitted to our hospital for detailed examination. The patient was diagnosed with right testicular tumor, multiple brain metastases, multiple lung metastases and right kidney metastases, and was transferred to our urology department. Since the testicular tumor was staged as IIIC and identified as poor prognosis by the International Germ Cell Consensus classification (IGCCC), Bleomycin Etoposide Cisplatin (BEP) chemotherapy was initiated prior to surgery. A right high orchiectomy was performed after two courses of BEP chemotherapy. Histopathology revealed mixed germ cell tumors (seminoma and/or embryonal carcinoma+teratoma) along with the following results : ly (-) ; Intratubular Malignant Germ Cells (ITMGC) (+, viable) ; tunica albuginea invasion (-) ; spermatic cord invasion (-) ; tumor size (73× 50×45 mm). Two additional courses of BEP chemotherapy and two courses of Paclitaxel Ifomaide Cisplatin(TIP) chemotherapy were performed successively. The CT revealed metastatic lesions shrinking steadily but the metastatic foci still remained. Since tumor markers were not negative, continuous chemotherapy was considered. However, strong side effects were expected, and treatment was discontinued. Since then,the tumors continued to shrink, and the tumor markers became negative. Currently, the patient maintains complete response and is being followed-up.
abstract_ja: 39歳男性が脳神経症状を呈し、地元の病院でCTにより脳腫瘍が発見されたため、当科脳神経外科に紹介された。痙攣症状のため、詳細な検査目的で当院に入院した。右精巣腫瘍、多発脳転移、多発肺転移、右腎転移と診断され、泌尿器科に転科となった。精巣腫瘍は国際胚細胞コンセンサス分類(IGCCC)によりIIIC期かつ予後不良と分類されたため、手術前にブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン(BEP)化学療法を開始した。BEP化学療法2コース後に右高位精巣摘除術を施行した。病理組織学的検査では、混合型胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマおよび/または胎児性癌+奇形腫)が認められ、以下の所見が得られた：ly(-)；精細管内悪性胚細胞(ITMGC)(+、生存)；白膜浸潤(-)；精索浸潤(-)；腫瘍径(73×50×45mm)。その後、BEP化学療法を2コース、パクリタキセル・イホスファミド・シスプラチン(TIP)化学療法を2コース、順次施行した。CTでは転移巣が着実に縮小したが、転移病変は残存していた。腫瘍マーカーが陰性化していなかったため、化学療法の継続が検討された。しかし、強い副作用が予想されたため、治療は中止された。その後、腫瘍は縮小を続け、腫瘍マーカーは陰性化した。現在、患者は完全奏効を維持しており、経過観察中である。
